name: Titaanium Ten Enterprise Limited
about: Titaanium Ten Enterprise Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of yarn and knitted fabrics in India. The company trades in grey cloth, curtains, and knitted fabrics; hires goods vehicle and machinery; and acts as a commission agent. It also exports its products. Titaanium Ten Enterprise Limited was founded in 1980 and is based in Surat, India.
